title: Invalid shield order subtype preceded repeated native crashes
claim: In one Namemerchants save, a MakeShield manager order created by our assistant had item_subtype -1. Repeated native crashes stopped after correcting it to the loaded ITEM_SHIELD_SHIELD subtype. Native crash output saying no Lua involvement did not rule out invalid API-created data.
reproduction: Do not recreate malformed orders in a live save. On an isolated backed-up test save, inspect equipment manager-order subtypes against loaded item definitions. The installed military order library specifies ITEM_SHIELD_SHIELD. Use a concrete loaded subtype when creating shield orders and verify actual item production.
evidence: Local repeated crash reports identified offset D05598 and the carpenter while advancing unit moves.
Native inspection found MakeShield order subtype -1. Correction produced two wooden shields; the same fortress subsequently advanced over 100000 ticks without that crash recurring.
A local preflight now rejects malformed equipment-order subtypes before simulation advances.
limitations: One observed save and version pair; not an independently reproduced controlled experiment or proof that every crash at this offset has this cause. No save, raw telemetry, credentials, or executable code is included. AI-assisted report; original summary offered under CC BY 4.0.
